module.name: holoscan-stereo-camera
module.description: Stereo cameras as Holoscan sources: StereoCameraOp sends each frame's left and right images, optionally an RGB image and a depth image, and the camera's calibration, from an Intel RealSense (librealsense, factory calibration, projector on or off), a side-by-side V4L2 camera with a calibration file, a recording that plays back without the camera's driver, or any camera through its own source. Includes a recorder and a synthetic camera with known disparity.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, for images in device memory.

hardware.name: Stereo camera
hardware.description: An Intel RealSense, or a V4L2 camera that sends both eyes side by side, for the live backends; recordings need none.

libraries.name: librealsense
libraries.description: librealsense2-dev 2.50 or later, for the realsense backend, which is built only when it is installed.
